Introducing MathEconLib, a Lean library for mathematical economics, launched in partnership between academic economists and Axiom Math.

  • https://mathecon.dev
  • https://github.com/matheconlib/matheconlib

Our goal is to develop a reusable library of machine-checked economic theory spanning micro, macro and econometrics.

We care about how economic models, assumptions, and results should be represented in a common Lean library, so that developments across papers and fields can fit together.

We build on Mathlib, are licensed under Apache 2.0, and plan to upstream broadly useful results to Mathlib where appropriate. Feedback and collaborators welcome! 

Contributors: @Ruize Chen, @Bo Cowgill , @Ben Eltschig , @Nikhil Garg, Ziv Hellman, @Scott Duke Kominers, @Moran Koren, @Dan, @Ken Ono, and Jujian Zhang.
